items.claim: Ramsey Nijem possesses first or second-round finish upside.
items.quote: Ramse Brahimage who has that first round maybe second round finish upside

items.claim: Neil Magny tends to look poor early before his opponents fatigue, allowing him to secure late finishes or decisions.
items.quote: Neil Magny who he's one of these guys that he's going to look awful and then his opponents gass out and he pulls that rabbit out of his hat and gets that late finish or wins a decision.

items.claim: Ramsey Nijem has a strong opportunity to submit Neil Magny in the first or second round.
items.quote: I think he's going to have a good opportunity to submit Neil Magny in the first or the second round.

items.claim: Neil Magny is capable of hanging in fights and wearing on opponents in the clinch as the fight progresses.
items.quote: if Magny's able to hang in there, you know, wear on Brahimage in the clinch
